title: Strict tenancy всех boundaries и единый фазовый barrier
summary: Strict opt-in tenancy изолирует drive/node/revision/upload/grants/shares/activity и очереди; explicit maintenance closure не протекает. Последний item квалифицирует весь интегрированный результат P3 одним non-mutation broad набором.
why: Current host-scoping warning не гарантирует tenant isolation в production. TenantResolver read-only contract, raw model resolution, jobs и system path — реальные authority boundaries.

include: Contracts/Tenancy/{TenantResolver,ResolvesOwnerTenant}, TenancyConfig typed resolver binding+all-env boot validation; TenancyBoundary scoped current read per operation, string normalization with null denied, disabled default remains.

Stamp provisioning and authoritative children tenant; owner tenant validation on lookup/provision/find; existing owner/profile unique winner mismatch deny, no second wrong-tenant row. Handle/factory/manager/NodeLocator/guard every call incl system and late queue call checks current drive.

HttpResourceResolver and request route resolution drive/node/revision/upload/grant/share scoped via owning drive tenant; all list/search/shared/trash/activity/Filament read paths constrained. Custom host global scopes дополнительны, не доказательство strict isolation. Core-only/public share token context controlled by hash/link+owning drive, not user-selected tenant.

RestoreTenantContext job middleware payload validation, read-only resolver нельзя setter; host tenancy restoration middleware before Vaulter validation. Missing/mismatch tenant or missing user -> fail без retry/без работы, ActorRef rehydration through Auth provider and current permissions. Scan internal system still same tenant; Webhook jobs без drive остаются вне invent user authority, drive-scoped jobs требуют payload tenant.

Vaulter::withoutTenancy closure scoped/reentrant try/finally; maintenance commands GC/reconcile/repair/purge-trash/sweep explicit wrapper+system reason, no HTTP control path. Replace/delete TenantFootgunGuard and callers/test/doc warning assumptions.

Integrate P3.8 phase barrier: phase.validation V901… contains exact local full six packages Pest/Pint/PHPStan once, PG critical matrices once, OPUS/structural freshness; execution receipts tie candidate/input closure. Hosted CI отдельный O-3, НЕ implicit локальный acceptance и НЕ dispatch mutation-enabled workflow. Выдаёт local qualification и честно external pending.
C03/C04/C08 final boundary includes scan-work lease/recovery PG and private scanner tenant capability; P3 receipts map C01–C04/C07/C08 scope, later C05/C06/C09/C10 remain pending future owners.

C03/C04/C08 strict tenant handling of activation/reconcile/backfill/scanner and cleanup; actual PrivateScannerTenantBoundaryTest before bytes, maintenance bypass never queue public authority; final phase receipts for current C01–C04/C07/C08, no closure claim C05/C06/C09/C10.
exclude: Автоматическое переключение host tenancy SDK/database; готовые vendor resolvers; public release/push/hosted CI; P4–P8 implementation.

guidance:
Implement strict scope centrally, not ad-hoc test-only tenant filters. Normalization preserves string id (including UUID/ULID and leading zeros), int converted to decimal string; null never matches. Boot requires valid resolver but does not require current for maintenance CLI. Native RestoreTenantContext validates host middleware already established tenant; cannot restore host tenancy from TenantResolver.current alone. Explicit error before work and bounded failure state, next not called; finally clears only Vaulter expectation/bypass depth. Same handle reused after resolver changes rejects without cached authority. HTTP anonymous share uses limited ShareContext and guarded target-scoped query; no broad bypass leakage. withoutTenancy disabled false/off still closure restoration semantics. Test V08/V31 through direct PHP/HTTP/jobs/Filament, system foreign404, null refusal, default non-tenant happy paths, lost actor/grant since dispatch, cross-tenant owner unique race, mutable passed model and maintenance nested exceptions. Run focused checks first; final full matrix once as declared phase barrier, no redundant reruns of covered focused dirs.

TenantJobBoundaryTest rejects forged revision/blob/drive/tenant/attempt before private scanner bytes; quarantine service read scoped, no public system escape. Final P3 V90 consumes new phase/V927–V929 as applicable plus relevant C-row receipts; never claim future P5/P7/P8 correction closure.

validation.procedure: На own candidate по уже записанному D25 check-profile выполнить Pint --test для перечисленных там фактически изменённых/новых owning PHP файлов (root binary scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pint; sibling binary ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pint, cwd своего пакета). Пустой PHP impact отмечается non-applicable с основанием. PHPStan core: scripts/php84 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon --memory-limit=1G --no-progress, cwd root. Для каждого фактически затронутого sibling: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M --no-progress, cwd packages/name из check-profile. Чужие dirty файлы не включать. Каждый исполненный command/cwd/list/env/exit сохранить; это exact impact-derived procedure по D25, не file filter для PHPStan.
validation.expect: Все соответствующие exact commands имеют exit 0, skipped/deferred не GREEN

validation.procedure:
Adversarial self-check модели P3-invariants: отметить применимые invariants/enforcement/callers/negative cases и lock pair matrix. Для нового guard ограниченный negative control: в isolated временной копии отключить одну owning проверку, запустить её именованный acceptance тест и получить RED, восстановить исходный SHA-256 и подтвердить GREEN. Сохранить command/cwd/env/exit/fingerprint. Не запускать mutation campaign. Supplemental D06 controls ALL required, fault definition in P3-security-contracts#Acceptance; each executed only inside isolated temporary repository copy, cwd relative to that isolated root, same env. Exact commands:
NC-SCANNER: cwd=packages/drive; env APP_ENV=testing DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=:memory: ../../scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Tenancy/PrivateScannerTenantBoundaryTest.php --filter=SEC-R12
Each control requires named matched test>=1/skipped=0, injected RED then exact source SHA restoration and original GREEN; receipts cannot substitute unrelated tests or silent skipped filters. No product controls run in design.
validation.expect: All applicable declared limited controls have RED→exact restored GREEN, candidate source hashes unchanged, named counts/output recorded; no mutation engine.
